The post Consumers Use AI Assistants but Hesitate to Hand Over Their Wallets appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Recent research reveals that while a large majority of consumers use artificial intelligence assistants, very few trust the technology to handle payments on their behalf. According to findings from Visa, establishing trusted payment methods will be crucial for the widespread adoption of agentic commerce. Despite high engagement with AI tools, consumer hesitation around financial transactions remains a significant barrier for the industry.
